verdict.rationale: The 9950X3D is a desktop X3D gaming CPU; the evidence pack contains no claim of an on-die NPU/neural engine, no TOPS figure, and no precision spec for this SKU — only a generic 'Ryzen AI Software For Developers' link that is boilerplate across AMD's product pages and not tied to an NPU on this chip. Without a published TOPS number or SDK specifically for this part's AI acceleration hardware, the story is unmet.
